newsitem.title: USA: Mobil, Phillips bid $10.5 mln for deepwater tracts.
newsitem.headline: Mobil, Phillips bid $10.5 mln for deepwater tracts.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Friday Mobil Exploration & Producing U.S. Inc and Phillips Petroleum Co were the apparent high bidders on 21 of 36 deepwater blocks for which they offered $10.5 million.

Mobil said it also was the apparent successful bidder on two of three deepwater blocks sought at Wednesday's federal lease sale in New Orleans in which it will have 100 percent equity. The company bid $2.8 million to win these blocks.
In order to accelerate exploration activities in the deepwater Gulf of Mexico, Mobil Exploration has formed Deepwater Business Unit, the company said.

This unit's objective is to build a top-tier business in this key exploration area. It will be headed by J.G. (Jim) Taylor, a 22-year Mobil employee with extensive international and U.S. exploration experience.
The majority of these blocks bid on this week are in the Garden Banks and Keathley Canyon areas, Mobil said.

The company and Phillips recently signed an agreement enabling them to leverage resources to reduce risks and costs, share technical capabilities and accelerate exploration in the deepwater Gulf of Mexico. Under the agreement, equity participation is two-thirds Mobil and one-third Phillips.
